IncidentDef.label: Elend Venture arrives
IncidentDef.letterText: He arrives on foot, without escort, carrying a satchel of books and no weapon worth the name. The heir to House Venture has spent his inheritance on an argument nobody in Luthadel wanted to hear: that a city can be governed by something other than fear. His father has armies. Elend has a theory of government and a habit of reading through meetings.\n\nHe asks whether he might stay. He does not mention that staying will make his father your enemy.

IncidentDef.label: a bead in the mists
IncidentDef.letterText:
The mists came in thicker than they should have, and they did not move the way mist moves. They gathered. Someone watching from the doorway said afterwards that it looked less like weather and more like a hand closing.

When they thinned there was a bead lying on the ground, pale and faintly luminous, warm to the touch in a way nothing that small should be. Lerasium. The metal the Lord Ruler was made from, and there is no vault within a thousand miles that could have lost it.

Something is still awake out there, and it has decided you should have this.
